description: RCS business messaging agents on the brand's own Telnyx account (Twilio creates RCS senders only in its Console; rcs_setup covers Twilio). action capabilities (numbers: which phones take RCS from this agent, up to 50) | list_brands | get_brand (rcsBrandId) | list_agents (default; rcsBrandId optional) | get_agent | create_agent (rcsBrandId, displayName, useCase MULTI_USE, PROMOTIONAL, TRANSACTIONAL or OTP, profile { description, logoUrl, bannerUrl, accentColor, privacyPolicyUrl, termsUrl, and phone, website or email }; a draft, nothing billed) | update_agent (before it is submitted) | submit_agent (Telnyx bills its one-time vetting fee) | launch_agent (campaign and testing objects as Telnyx asks; Telnyx bills its launch fee and starts the monthly agent fee) | list_test_devices | add_test_device (phoneNumber: sends a tester invitation) | remove_test_device (testDeviceId or phoneNumber) | deactivate_agent (says where it is done). agentId is optional when there is one agent. submit_agent, launch_agent and add_test_device change nothing without confirm:true; show the user the dry run first. Free in Hermoso; Telnyx bills its fees. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
